patch.title: 重构引言为四段递进结构（背景→问题→方法→贡献），保留 \cite{lee2021}、91.2% 准确率、Metro 测试集与三条贡献，并用 TODO 注释标出需作者补充的背景与问题内容。

hunks.oldText: Background and motivation are described briefly. The research gap is not yet explicit. Our method uses a constrained encoder for traffic prediction. The contributions are: (1) a calibrated benchmark; (2) a robust encoder; (3) an open evaluation protocol. The method reaches 91.2\% accuracy on the Metro test set \cite{lee2021}.
